glossary.angular: Angular is a TypeScript framework for building large or complex web applications.
glossary.typescript: TypeScript is a programming language that adds static type checking to JavaScript.
glossary.nodeJs: Node.js is a runtime environment for running JavaScript outside a web browser, including on servers.
glossary.express: Express is a JavaScript framework for building web servers and APIs with Node.js.
glossary.scss: SCSS is an extension of CSS that adds features for organizing and reusing styles.
glossary.rxjs: RxJS is a JavaScript and TypeScript library for managing events and data that change over time.
glossary.docker: Docker is a platform for packaging and running applications in containers, keeping the environment consistent across development, testing and production.
glossary.api: An API is an interface that allows applications or services to exchange data.
glossary.restApi: A REST API is a type of web API that exchanges data through standard HTTP requests.
glossary.webSocket: WebSocket is a communication protocol that keeps a two-way connection open between a client and a server.
glossary.ros: ROS is a set of software tools for connecting a robot's software and hardware components.
glossary.mqtt: MQTT is a messaging protocol that uses little bandwidth and few device resources, making it suited to connected devices and constrained networks.
glossary.ai: AI is a field of technology that enables software to recognize patterns, interpret information and perform tasks.
glossary.gerrit: Gerrit is a source code review and repository management tool for Git that adds an approval workflow before changes are merged.
glossary.cSharp: C# is a programming language used mainly with .NET to build applications and services for Windows, Linux and macOS, with strong use in the Microsoft ecosystem.
glossary.dotNet: .NET is Microsoft's platform for building and running applications on Windows, Linux and macOS, with strong use in the Microsoft and Windows ecosystems.
glossary.winDev: WinDev is a WLanguage development environment for building database-backed business applications for Windows and Linux, with visual tools for creating interfaces.
glossary.sql: SQL is a language for storing, organizing and retrieving data in databases.
glossary.azureDevOps: Azure DevOps is a suite of services for planning, building, testing and releasing software.
glossary.fastApi: FastAPI is a Python framework for building web APIs.
glossary.python: Python is a programming language used for web services, automation, data processing and AI.
glossary.dynamics365: Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a suite of business applications for customer, sales and operational processes.
glossary.powerPlatform: Power Platform is a low-code platform for building applications and automating workflows.
glossary.ionic: Ionic is a JavaScript and TypeScript framework for building mobile applications with web technologies.
glossary.ngrx: NgRx is a TypeScript library for managing shared state in Angular applications.
glossary.seo: SEO is a set of practices that helps search engines understand and find a website.
glossary.ciCd: CI/CD is a development practice that automates software testing and delivery.

highlights: Lead the development of an autonomous agricultural robotics platform designed to remove weeds without toxic herbicides.
Drive software architecture, development activities, and technical direction across the robot software ecosystem.
Lead and coordinate development teams working on robot implementation, testing, validation, and field-ready software delivery.

Develop full-stack features for an Angular operator interface and a distributed architecture connecting multiple robots, each running a Node.js backend, to a chain of online Node.js servers. These servers handle security, routing, load balancing, and communication with multiple SQL and NoSQL databases, including logging stores.
Collaborate with robotics, AI, and hardware engineers to integrate AI-powered weed detection into operational workflows.
Managed the full development cycle of critical applications supporting operational processes in a regulated nuclear environment.
Designed and delivered tools for personnel accreditation, sealed source management, technical equipment requalification, and long-term operation support.
Built secure and reliable software solutions focused on efficiency, traceability, compliance, and operational continuity.
Led front-end development of an internal recruitment platform connected to a FastAPI Python backend.
Implemented AI-assisted features to process CV files, extract relevant information, and support recruiter workflows.
Defined coding standards, reusable patterns, and best practices to improve maintainability and delivery quality.
Strengthened communication between Procter & Gamble managers, Akkodis managers, and a team of 25 on-site consultants.
Coordinated consultant onboarding and provided ongoing support throughout their assignments.
Prospected for new missions and opportunities with the client.
Organized after-work events to foster connection and team cohesion among consultants.
For the Liquid Fabric Enhancers (LFE) department, architected and developed an Angular application integrated with REST APIs and a C#/.NET backend.
Connected multiple data sources, including Siemens, custom, and local databases.
Built data visualization features including graphs, tables, image rendering, and analytical views.
Delivered a feature-rich application helping stakeholders retrieve filtered samples and generate actionable insights.
For the Analytical (ANA) and Soluble Unidoses (SUD) departments, designed and optimized C# microprocesses tailored to analytical and laboratory workflows.
Automated experiment file uploads, data extraction, calculations, and secure database integration.
Supported approximately 15 chemical testing methods while improving productivity, data integrity, and process reliability.
Completed an intensive training program focused on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 suite.
Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to deliver a final project based on Dynamics 365 solutions.
Led the team project through delivery of the Dynamics 365 solution.
Maintained and enhanced mobile applications built with Angular and Ionic.
Worked on geolocation features, RxJS-based flows, NgRx state management, and mobile UI styling.
Contributed to research and development initiatives focused on user experience and application performance.
Worked on a full-stack application for managing room reservations in public services.
Contributed to the Angular front end and Node.js backend, including business logic and database interactions.
Participated in user interface design and integration between the different parts of the application.
